defects: ROBUSTNESS (non-blocking): `SpanAssociator.add` validates nothing (`percept/individuation.py:133-147`). A malformed candidate is ACCEPTED on the first add (`count()` becomes 1) and only blows up on the SECOND add, when `_same_event` (`percept/individuation.py:104-116`) dereferences `cand.kind` — `AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'kind'`. The error therefore surfaces one unit LATE and names the wrong call. No Stage-2 correctness property in SV-2.5/2.6/2.7 depends on it, so it is reported, not failed.
